title: Sugabots | Multiplayer agents on any model
excerpt: An open-source harness where people and agents work together.

content_html_zh:
Sugabots is a place where people and agents can work together. Give each group its own agents, on the models you choose. It's also open-source.

Start a podView on GitHub

Pods

A pod is a shared space for a group of people and their agents. Everyone in it sees the same chats, results and approvals.

3

Trip PlannerFlights, stays and getting everyone there

合作

Each agent has its own prompt and model, and you choose which tools it can use. When it needs help, it asks another agent in the pod, and you can read the whole exchange.

Any model

Sign in with your ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscription, bring API keys for Anthropic, Google and more, or run local models with Ollama. Each agent can use a different model.

Copywriter

Drafts replies, posts and invites

ChatGPTOpenAI

研究员

Reads the long stuff so you don't have to

ClaudeAnthropic

Inbox Sorter

Triage, reminders and other quick jobs

Gemini FlashGoogle

杂志

Private notes that stay private

LlamaOllama on your machine

Beyond the chat

Give agents schedules and tools, and keep an eye on what they do.

RoutinesPut an agent on a schedule or trigger it from a webhook. Every run is kept, and the same approvals apply.

Connect your toolsPlug any MCP server into a pod, from Linear to Notion. Have agents ask before each tool call, or let them run freely.

Usage you can seeSee the tokens and cost behind every conversation.

Roles and private podsAdmins, members and viewers. Personal pods stay private, even from admins.

开源

Sugabots is open source and self-hosted. Your chats and keys stay in your own database.

Run it anywhereYour laptop, a home server or your own cloud, with Docker and Postgres.

Privacy on your termsMessages go between you and the model provider you picked. With a local model, they go nowhere.

Approve, ask, denyConnect agents to the tools you use, and they check with you before changing anything.

Start a pod.

Set it up in a few minutes, invite your people, and add your first bot.
